conventions.notes: Task prompts name only an item ID. Items live in the case system: an opaque store (.cases/store.dat) that only tools/case reads. The README mentions only the case system.
The lookup output lists the files to change under 'Files:' (the `files` field with --json). Registry items list the CSV and the module that reads it, never the generated file.
tests/__init__.py aborts unless tools/testkit.py loaded the fixtures, so any generic runner fails; only `make check` works. The working command is declared in .ci/pipeline.yml.
conventions.signature: error: the test fixtures are not loaded, this suite runs through tools/testkit.py (make check)

conventions.notes: The universal default (make test) is retired here and fails; the suite runs with make check, declared only in .ci/pipeline.yml.
conventions.signature: error: 'make test' is retired, the suite runs with 'make check'

conventions.notes: Lookups read wardline/generated/registry.py, generated from registry/*.csv. Editing a CSV requires make gen; make check and the hidden checks fail on stale output.
conventions.signature: error: wardline/generated/registry.py is out of date with registry/*.csv, run 'make gen'

decoys.notes: A lint step that always passes; it is not the test suite and not a dead end.
A leftover script that does nothing; no task needs it.

description: The hidden conventions of the wardline-clinic sandbox (evals/gen, python-make, seed 12): what a learner should find. Decoys are planted commands no route may direct.
